meta.name: Ensure File Storage File System access is restricted to root users
meta.description: Ensure File Storage File System access is restricted to root users
meta.remediation: Avoid identity_squash = "ROOT" on oci_file_storage_export export_options; if root squashing is required, pin anonymous_uid and anonymous_gid to 65534.

evaluators.description: No export_options entry squashes to ROOT. NotContainedIn with a list passes on a null input, so an entry that omits identity_squash (padded to null by the wildcard) passes.
